name: Inception Fist
description: Strike with a fist in which a new force is born at the moment of contact.

name: Inception Step
description: Bring a footing into being where the foot lands and stride on to the next.

name: Inception Mend
description: Bring new flesh into being over a hurt on an ally or the user.

name: Inception Bind
description: Bring bands of new force into being about a foe's limbs and draw them tight.

name: Inception Bolt
description: Bring a bolt of force into being in the hand and loose it at a distant target.

name: Inception Ward
description: Bring a ward into being before a blow and let it break on the strike.

name: Inception Surge
description: Bring a surge of force into being among the foes and loose it in every direction.

name: Inception Veil
description: Bring a veil into being that lets lesser strikes pass through the user unfelt.

name: Grand Inception
description: Bring a great burning force into being at the heart of the field and let it burst outward.

name: Fiat Jab
description: Speak a short command and jab with a fist that arrives as ordered.

name: Fiat Step
description: Command the ground ahead to hold and stride across it without a stumble.

name: Fiat Guard
description: Command a blow to turn and force it to glance from the forearm.

name: Fiat Calm
description: Command an ally's racing heart to steady so they act with a clear head.

name: Fiat Bind
description: Command a foe's limbs to stay and make the command hold with bands of qi.

name: Fiat Edge
description: Command an edge to exist along the hand and cut with it at once.

name: Fiat Cleanse
description: Command taint to leave an ally's blood and make clean blood in its place.

name: Fiat Shell
description: Command a wall to stand between user and foe and make it hold against the first blows.

name: Fiat Verdict
description: Pronounce a verdict on a foe and make the weight of it fall on their shoulders.

name: Fiat Absolute
description: Declare a foe's guard broken with the whole will and make the break real.

name: Spring Strike
description: Strike with a fist fed from a spring of qi so each blow hits fresh.

name: Spring Leap
description: Let a jet of the spring push the user into a long low leap.

name: Spring Salve
description: Draw clear qi from the spring over an ally's wound and close it.

name: Spring Chain
description: Spring chains of clear qi up about a foe's limbs and tighten them.

name: Spring Dart
description: Send a jet of the spring from the palm like a dart at a foe.

name: Spring Cloak
description: Wear a flowing cloak of the spring that slides blows aside.

name: Spring Flood
description: Let the spring flood outward over the field and bear foes off their feet.

name: Spring Renewal
description: Pour the spring into a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped and drive the breath back.

name: Spring Surge
description: Raise the whole spring in one surge that sweeps the field and scours it clean.

name: Plan Strike
description: Strike where the plan has already placed the blow and let the fist arrive on time.

name: Plan Step
description: Make each footfall of a stride in thought first and then in qi under the foot.

name: Plan Brace
description: Make a brace of qi about an ally's stance and steady the strikes that follow.

name: Plan Chain
description: Make a chain by plan link by link around a foe in a moment.

name: Plan Bolt
description: Make a bolt from a plan and loose it so it flies true over a long range.

name: Plan Guard
description: Make the guard the plan calls for in the hand's width before the blow.

name: Plan Carapace
description: Make a full bastion of qi about the user from the plan in the mind.

name: Plan Barrage
description: Make a whole battery of bolts at once and loose them across the field.

name: Plan Fulfilled
description: Make the whole plan stand complete in the field and bring all of it down on the foes.

name: Loom Strike
description: Strike with a fist wrapped in woven strands of new qi.

name: Loom Step
description: Weave a thread of qi under the foot and slip along it.

name: Loomed Screen
description: Weave a close screen of strands before the chest that takes a blow.

name: Loom Warmth
description: Weave a warm cloth of qi about an ally and ease the strain of cold and weariness.

name: Loom Bind
description: Weave strands about a foe's arms and legs into a close web.

name: Loom Cut
description: Weave a taut strand into a wire and draw it through the foe.

name: Loom Mend
description: Weave strands of new flesh across an ally's wound and draw its edges together.

name: Loom Shroud
description: Weave a deep shroud over the user where lesser strikes lose their way.

name: Loom Pattern
description: Weave a wide pattern of cutting strands that falls across every foe in the field.

name: Loom Tapestry
description: Weave a vast tapestry of living strands over the field that cuts and binds all within.

name: Anvil Fist
description: Make an anvil of qi at the back of the foe's guard and strike the guard onto it.

name: Anvil Step
description: Make a small anvil under the foot and spring off it to a far spot.

name: Anvil Face
description: Hold an anvil face before the body and glance blows away from it.

name: Anvil Bind
description: Make a pair of anvils on either side of a foe's feet and clamp them fast.

name: Anvil Strike
description: Bring a made hammer down onto the foe as upon an anvil.

name: Anvil Ward
description: Make an anvil-faced ward before the user that rings under a blow and holds.

name: Anvil Press
description: Make a great anvil above a foe and lower it until they cannot rise.

name: Anvil Rain
description: Make a hundred small anvils in the air and let them fall on the foes.

name: Anvil Crash
description: Make a vast anvil and hammer in one act and bring the hammer down so the foe is flattened.
